publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for organization business-unit routes and behavior.
Service contract for business-unit hierarchy and membership target validation.

dependsOn.description: Business units resolve their owning Organization through the organizationCore public service seam.
Tenant-admin business-unit routes require an active tenant session context.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing business-unit hierarchy, depth, or branch archive semantics can break memberships, exports, and future reporting slices.
Changing business-unit route context behavior can break root and tenant scoped child-resource consumers.
